propositions: T3 and T10 criteria must transition from non-blocking to blocking-postured with block_threshold 0.90 to enable actionable findings to block plan review.

T10 findings must be scoped to MAJOR-class infra/IaC issues through severity guidance so only destructive apply, wildcard grants, plaintext secrets, and unauthenticated services can reach the 0.90 priority threshold.

A T10 DetGateRule must pre-gate plan review on infrastructure-related vocabulary (terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS services, GitHub Actions workflows, systemd, Docker) to avoid LLM routing on non-infra plans.
Pinned test assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py must reflect T3/T10 blocking configuration and the approved-blocking-criteria set must include both criteria.
Unit tests must verify T3 and T10 findings block at priority >= 0.90 and remain advisory below threshold through Pass-3.
The T10 rubric in plan_review_T10.md must document the MAJOR-class severity constraint and the criteria guide must be regenerated.
